title.narrative: Heilongjiang Energy Efficient District Heating Project

description.narrative: The proposed project will expand and upgrade district heating systems (DHSs) in eight cities of Heilongjiang province to make the systems energy efficient, thereby reducing emission of greenhouse gases and air pollutants. The project will install energy efficient heating sources and heat exchangers, insulated pipelines, and computerized monitoring and control systems.

description.narrative: Improved air quality and reduced greenhouse gas emissions in six urban areas in Heilongjiang province

By 2018, the air quality in the project targeted areas improves to at least class II (baseline: Class III in 2011) Progress/Status: Beijing monitored with support of loan implementation consultants Data Source: Heilongjiang province statistical year book Base year: 2011 Baseline value: N

By 2018, the project reduces annual raw coal consumption of more than 552,907 tons, thereby avoiding annual emissions of 777,974 tons of carbon dioxide, 3,529 tons of SO2, 68,928 tons of total suspended particulates, and 7,751 tons of NOx, compared with 2012 Progress/Status: Beijing monitored with support of loan implementation consultants Data Source: Heilongjiang province statistical year book Base year: 2012 Baseline value: N
Output/s as listed by the project staff.
